<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/bundle_deal/get_bundle_deal_list?access_token=access_token&page_no=1&page_size=100&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&time_status=2&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: bundle_deal_list
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The list of bundle deal id

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: bundle_deal_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Shopee's unique identifier for a bundle deal activity.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: name
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Title of the bundle deal

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: start_time
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The time when bundle deal activity start.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: end_time
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The time when bundle deal activity end.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: rule_type
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The bundle deal rule type：FIX_PRICE = 1 ；DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE = 2； DISCOUNT_VALUE = 3

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: discount_value
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The deducted price when when buying a bundle deal. Need to input it when the bundle deal rule type is 3

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: fix_price
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The amount of the buyer needs to spend to purchase a bundle deal. Need to input it when the bundle deal rule type is 1

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: discount_percentage
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The discount that the buyer can get when buying a bundle deal. Need to input it when the bundle deal rule type is 2

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: min_amount
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The quantity of items that need buyer to combine purchased

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: additional_tiers
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Use to create tiered discount for bundle deals, a max of 2 additional tiers are allowed to create bundle deals like buy 2 get 10% off, buy 3 for 15% off, buy 4 for 20% off; For each tier, we will need to set the following 4 values based on bundle deal type + min_amount = IntAttribute() + fix_price = IntAttribute() + discount_percentage = IntAttribute() + discount_value = IntAttribute() Note: for additional tiers, the fix price, discount_percentage, discount_value should be consistent with tier 1

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: min_amount
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The quantity of items that the buyers need to purchase for additional tier

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: fix_price
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The bundle price when the buyers purchase a bundle deal for additional tiers. Need to input it when the bundle deal rule type is 1.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: discount_value
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The bundle deal discount amount the buyer can save when purchasing a bundle deal. Need to input it when the bundle deal rule type is 3

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: discount_percentage
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The bundle deal discount% that the buyer can get when buying a bundle deal for additional tiers. Need to input it when the bundle deal rule type is 2

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: purchase_limit
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Maximum number of bundle deals that can be bought by a buyer.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: more
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: this field shows whether there are more bundle deals in next page or not
